title: Apple just shared some staggering statistics about how well the App Store is doing (AAPL)
text: Apple just shared some staggering statistics about how well the App Store is doing (AAPL) By Kif Leswing Jan 4, 2018, 5:03 pm 24 pts Apple announced new App Store statistics on Thursday. It revealed for the first time that over half a billion iPhone and iPad users visit the App Store every week.
